BS Car Rentals

How your new business system works, in 11 simple steps.

Cars · Customers · Rentals · Payments · Damage · Reminders · Reports

Demo: customers and registration numbers are samples
1. Open the dashboard2. Your cars3. Your customers4. Rent a car5. Track every trip6. Car comes back7. Everything is saved8. Money Due9. Service and papers10. Reports11. Staff logins
1

Open the dashboard

Everything at a glance, the moment you sign in.

  • How many cars are free, rented, reserved or at the garage
  • Money collected this month and money customers still owe
  • Who has which car, overdue returns and today's reminders

Swipe to see more →

2

Your cars

All 25 cars and scooters with photo, price and status.

  • Statuses change by themselves: Available, Currently rented, Reserved
  • Mark a car Under maintenance when it is at the garage
  • Open any car to see its history, damage, service and papers

Swipe to see more →

3

Your customers

Add a customer once, then just pick them next time.

  • How many times they rented, and which cars
  • Total paid and money still due
  • Any damage from past trips
4

Rent a car

Pick the customer, the car and the dates.

  • The price is worked out by itself (3 days × ₹3,000 = ₹9,000)
  • Enter the advance and the security deposit
  • Note the km, fuel and any scratches before the car goes out
  • Two customers can never get the same car at the same time

Swipe to see more →

5

Track every trip

See all cars out with customers, and when each one returns.

  • Time left, or how late an overdue car is
  • Rental amount, money received and money remaining
  • Every payment is saved with a receipt; nothing is ever erased

Swipe to see more →

6

Car comes back

Fill in the return form.

  • Final km, fuel and condition
  • New damage is recorded with the customer and the trip
  • Damage is charged only if you agree with the customer
  • Take the final payment and return the deposit

Swipe to see more →

7

Everything is saved

After the return, the full story of the trip stays on record.

  • Final bill, payments and what is still due
  • Before vs after: km, fuel and condition side by side
  • Damage history for the car and the customer

Swipe to see more →

8

Money Due

One screen shows who owes you money.

  • Amount, due date and how many days late
  • Tap WhatsApp to send a polite reminder
  • See which customers have paid in full

Swipe to see more →

9

Service and papers

Reminders before insurance or PUC expire, and when a service is due.

  • Reminders 30, 15, 7 and 1 day before expiry
  • Renewed? Enter the new date and the reminder goes away
  • Service done? Record it and the next service date is set
10

Reports

Your business in numbers.

  • Total rentals and money collected each month
  • Car-wise and customer-wise history
  • Download any report to Excel
11

Staff logins

Give staff their own login and choose what they can see.

  • Staff cannot see money, reports or customer ID numbers unless you allow it
  • Only you can cancel a payment or approve a damage charge
  • Every change is recorded with who did it

Everything in one place

Works on phone, tablet and computer.

Opens at bscarrental.co.in/manage, with your own login.
